laws.rule: Under a prefectural ordinance, the Mt Fuji Yoshida Trail (1 July to 10 September) charges JPY 4,000 per person per climb, closes the 5th Station gate from 2 pm to 3 am (except for mountain-hut guests) and caps climbers at 4,000 a day. Outside the season the trail above the 5th Station is closed.

festivals.what: Yoshida Fire Festival (Kitaguchi Hongu Fuji Sengen Shrine and Suwa Shrine, Fujiyoshida): 26 and 27 August, marking the close of the Fuji climbing season. About 80 tall torches are lit in the streets on the 26th; the Susuki festival follows on the afternoon of the 27th.
